cue.box_squat: Sit down slowly and stand up through your heels.
cue.glute_bridge: Squeeze your glutes at the top, hold for 1 count.
cue.step_up: Push through the leg on the step.
cue.single_leg_bridge: Keep your hips level, do not let them drop.
cue.db_row: Pull your elbow to your hip, back straight.
cue.shoulder_press: Brace your belly, press straight up.
cue.band_pull_apart: Arms straight, squeeze your shoulder blades together.
cue.rdl: Hips back, keep the weight close to your legs.
cue.incline_pushup: Body in one line, chest to the edge.
cue.dead_bug: Lower back on the floor, breathe calmly.
cue.bird_dog: Reach long with arm and leg, hips still.
cue.leg_press: Feet hip-width, knees in line with your toes.
cue.hip_thrust: Chin to chest, drive your hips up.
cue.lat_pulldown: Pull the bar to your chest, shoulders down.
cue.cable_row: Back straight, pull your elbows along your sides.
cue.chest_press: Shoulder blades against the pad, push calmly.
